title: A photorealistic natural close-up bedroo
prompt:
A photorealistic natural close-up bedroom selfie-style photo of a fictional 20-year-old adult Japanese woman, clearly an adult, reimagined as a different person and not a real person likeness. Natural candid off-shot style, quiet intimate night mood, realistic smartphone photo.

Strict composition: vertical portrait framing, very close camera angle from slightly below eye level, as if the phone is held near her chest or blanket while she is lying on a bed. Her face fills the upper center of the frame, looking calmly into the camera. Her knees appear softly blurred in the lower foreground, creating depth, while a soft white and gray striped blanket covers her torso and rests across the lower part of the image.

She has a Japanese idol-like cute face, natural adult beauty, dark black-brown hair spread softly on the pillow, a few loose strands on her forehead, soft glossy lips slightly parted, relaxed sleepy eyes, natural eyebrows, subtle makeup, realistic pores, slight skin imperfections, natural facial asymmetry, not overly symmetrical, not plastic skin.

One hand is gently tucked under her chin in a relaxed pose, giving a quiet late-night feeling. The lighting is dim and cool-toned, like soft phone screen light mixed with faint bedroom ambient light. The background is dark and softly blurred, with a white pillow partially visible behind her head.

Her body is mostly covered by the white and gray striped blanket, keeping the image tasteful and non-revealing. The blanket should have a soft fleece or plush texture, gentle white and light gray horizontal stripes, natural folds, and soft shadows. Emphasize a calm private bedroom atmosphere, natural candid realism, realistic skin texture, soft low-light photography, shallow depth of field, high detail, photorealistic natural photo.

No social media overlay, no text, no icons, no watermark.
